title: Agreement Between Owner and Contractor – Rook Electric - Door Entry Systems Project - Group 3 - Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Agreement Between Owner and Contractor by and between the District and Rook Electric, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide following services: Installation of AIPhone door entry intercom systems at various sites including Cisco CP-8865 Desk Station, IX series Video Door Station shall be owner furnished contractor installed, Assa Abloy HES 9600 electric door strike, IXW-MA network relay, power supplies, conduit, wiring, training, and programming to include integration into Cisco Call Manager and Milestone X Protect surveillance camera software; coordinate with OUSD Tech Services as needed to complete programming at - Arroyo Viejo CDC, Stonehurst Campus (Fred T. headline: Hires Rook Electric for $125,000 to install door entry intercoms at 8 school sites (Group 3)
summary: Rook Electric of Oakland was the lowest responsive bidder to install door entry intercom systems, electric door strikes and related wiring, and to connect them to the district's phone and camera software. The amount includes an $11,500 contingency allowance, and work is expected to run 90 days from October 12, 2023 to January 9, 2024.
schools: Arroyo Viejo CDC; Fred T. Korematsu MS; Esperanza ES; Stonehurst CDC; Crocker Highlands ES; Life Academy; Martin Luther King Jr. ES; Martin Luther King Jr. CDC
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

summary: Building Block Interiors, the lowest responsible bidder, will provide, deliver and install Pre-K classroom furniture for the Laurel Child Development Center. The agreement lists a contingency allowance of $14,696.31. Work is scheduled from October 12, 2023 to January 1, 2024.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
